caption.line1: Comment HONEST for the one-line prompt that makes any AI check your work.
body: I pasted the same EXAMPLE weekly budget into ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude, all on free plans. The total was wrong on purpose (₹4,200 written, rows add up to ₹4,700).
What you need: any of the three free apps and your own plan, budget or schedule.
The catch: this is one test on one day. Any of the three can still flatter you. Chat AIs lean towards agreeing, so a polite answer is not a checked answer.
Send this to the colleague who pastes everything into ChatGPT before sending it to the manager.
Comment HONEST and I'll DM you the prompt.
